tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.40; also called Hodevah at Neh.7.43; Judah at Ezr.3.9;
§ Hodaviah = "praise ye Jehovah"
1) a man of Manasseh, one of the heads of the half tribe on the east of Jordan
2) a man of Benjamin, son of Has-senuah
3) a Levite, who seems to have given his name to an important family in the tribe

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Hodavjah, the name of three Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1935 (הוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ); majesty of Jah;
